verdict.rationale: Netlify supports Deploy Previews for every PR/branch and customizable preview environments for collaborators, which enables isolated environments per change so teams can work in parallel; community feedback corroborates PR preview builds as a standout feature. However, there's no explicit evidence of 'unlimited' environments, per-branch full-stack isolated dev environments (e.g., ephemeral backends/databases per branch), or scaling guarantees for large teams shipping simultaneously. missing for 10: explicit 'unlimited' environment claims, isolated backend/database-per-branch evidence, independent validation of scaling to large teams.
